description.p: Flowkeeper is a Pomodoro timer, which stays as close as possible to Pomodoro Technique description found in the original book by Francesco Cirillo. Featuring classic UI paradigm (desktop-first, no Electron), keyboard shortcuts and advanced settings, Flowkeeper is optimized for power users.

New features:
Full-screen rest notifications (#67)
Knocking sound to remind about approaching break (#67)
Configurable (F5) task categories / groups to help prioritize your work (#177)
Presets for some of the popular productivity methods: 1-2-3 Rule, ABCDE Method, Eisenhower Matrix, and more
Mute button in the focus mode (#151)
You can now undo task completion by pressing Ctrl+P again (#55, #198)
Main window is activated when another instance is launched (#89)
New themes, including Very Dark, Very Light and Reddit Light
New KDE-friendly "FK" logo and tray icon

Technical improvements:
Upgraded to Qt 6.11
Fixed a bunch of code quality issues reported by SonarQube
Switched to Nuitka 4.x to compile the binaries
RPM builds and Fedora repos in OBS (#127)
Converted all audio resources to m4a format
Metadata on workitems and backlogs (#112)
Snapcraft.io manifest
New build configurations: Ubuntu 26.04, macOS 26 and Windows 11 ARM
"About > System info" tab to help reporting issues

Bug fixes:
An issue when launching Flowkeeper during a long break
Two bugs with import/export handling of reordering
Drag-and-drop in Wayland (#223)
